title: Six-device M5Burner user-firmware simulation matrix

firmware.selection: MOST_DOWNLOADED; baseline UIFlow2 excluded where possible

checks.name: virtual_flash_and_static_validation
checks.detail: 18/18 merged images uploaded, composed and structurally validated

checks.name: session_lifecycle
checks.detail: 18/18 sessions reached a terminal stopped state with history retained

checks.name: display_frame_and_input
checks.detail: 11 PASS; two display samples lacked frame/input evidence

checks.name: serial_only_device
checks.detail: NanoC6 has no display; two samples passed serial/runtime checks

checks.name: ieee802154_zigbee
checks.detail: C6 QEMU has no IEEE 802.15.4 radio model; Zigbee task watchdog repeats

notes: PASS requires a non-blank application frame, a live session, no fatal serial signature and an observable input response.
Device Service startup failures are classified separately and are not attributed to firmware.
The matrix covers virtual-device behavior only; no physical hardware measurements were performed.
